tool_args.rationale: The five rows span only 0.018 in s_grad. Buy the targeted wide-gradient probe to separate vmax from rho and test the square-root branch against linear leakage. Fit afterward over the full fallback bounds so the warm-start box does not exclude low rho.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Near s_grad = 1, the pilot mainly identifies vmax × (1 − rho/2), not vmax and rho separately. A good pilot fit could still fail at other gradients.
It costs 4.5 versus 2.0 and does not directly target the missing gradient leverage. The pilot already matches the target horizon.
It does not resolve the gradient dependence or distinguish the residual branches.
